_about: Chaski color and type tokens. Decided D24 (SOT.md). The app imports these; never hard-code a color.
rules: Teal (action) is the only color for primary actions.
Red (block) only means 'Chaski did not say it' or a failed teach-back item. Never decorative.
Warnings always carry an icon, never color alone.
Chaski always sits on a card with the chaskiCardTop -> chaskiCardBottom gradient.

D28 (supersedes D24's single-strip rule): the manta is the identity layer. It lives only in decorative bands: header band, onboarding hero, the lliclla under Chaski, summary header, splash. Never inside a content card, never behind text.
Semantic colors (ok, warn, block) never change and never come from the manta palette.
A manta band never touches a status element: keep at least 12 pt of plain ground between them, so textile red or pink never reads as 'blocked'.
Teal (action) stays the only action color; turquoise in the manta is decoration, not a button.

manta._about: Tintes de la manta andina (D28), tomados a ojo de la referencia de Freddy (tela blanca con franjas y cadenas de rombos). Solo para bandas decorativas.
